# laravelforge_redirect_rule (Data Source)

Fetches a single redirect rule by ID on a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the redirect rule.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the redirect rule belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `from` (String) Source URL path.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status (`installing`, `installed`, or `removing`).
- `to` (String) Destination URL path.
- `type` (String) Redirect type (`redirect` or `permanent`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
